packs.name: Sensitive Domain Conservative Language
packs.description: Shared safety and review requirements for legal, medical, and financial research.

rules.description: Do not present the output as professional legal, medical, investment, tax, or accounting advice.
rules.required_action: Use informational language and recommend qualified human review.

rules.description: Any decisive claim must be backed by primary, official, regulatory, clinical, filing, or legal text sources.
rules.required_action: Downgrade or mark unsupported claims if primary sources are missing.

warnings.message: Sensitive-domain output should be reviewed by a qualified human before use.

packs.name: Current Information Freshness
packs.description: Freshness requirements for news, current events, pricing, law, market, and fast-moving software topics.

rules.description: Reports relying on current information must state the research date and flag stale or undated sources.
rules.required_action: Include date sensitivity and source freshness caveats in the instructions.

warnings.message: This protocol may require recent sources and explicit stale-source caveats.

packs.name: Software Primary Sources
packs.description: Primary-source expectations for software, API, framework, and implementation research.

source_requirements.rationale: Software claims should be anchored in official docs where possible.
Source repositories or release artifacts are valuable for implementation and risk claims.

warnings.message: Software APIs, pricing, and compatibility can change quickly; verify versions and dates.
